def validate_authority(request_ref,c):
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    q=decode(read_ref(request_ref))
    require(set(q)=={'schema','issued_by','selector','scope_ref','canonical_vector_ref','calling_contract_ref','scope_audit_ref'},'REQUEST_FIELDS')
    require(q['schema']=='researchos.root-w09-three-selector-native-request.v1' and q['issued_by']==ROOT_ACTOR
        and q['selector']==c['selector_key'] and Path(request_ref['path']).is_relative_to(W),'ROOT_REQUEST')
    sr=q['scope_ref'];scope=decode(read_ref(sr));contract_ref=pin(N/'root-calling-contract.json')
    require(q['calling_contract_ref']==contract_ref,'CURRENT_CALLING_CONTRACT')
    contract=decode(read_ref(contract_ref));require(set(scope)==set(contract['scope_required_fields']),'SCOPE_FIELDS')
    require(scope['schema']=='researchos.root-w09-three-selector-native-scope.v1'
        and scope['status']=='ROOT_AUTHORIZED_SINGLE_SELECTOR_NATIVE' and scope['issued_by']==scope['executor']==ROOT_ACTOR,'ROOT_SCOPE')
    require(all(scope[k] is False for k in BOOL_FALSE) and all(type(scope[k]) is int and scope[k]==0 for k in ZERO),'SCOPE_BOUNDARY')
    require(all(type(scope[k]) is int and scope[k]==v for k,v in {'maximum_go_test_runs':1,'maximum_go_list_runs':1,
        'list_timeout_seconds':240,'producer_timeout_seconds':420,'inner_Go_timeout_seconds':180}.items()),'FINITE_EXECUTION_BUDGET')
    href,mref,refs=package_refs()
    require(scope['source_handoff_ref']==href and scope['source_manifest_ref']==mref,'EXACT_SOURCE_PAIR')
    bound={key:pin(N/name) for key,name in contract['source_file_bindings'].items()}
    require(all(scope[k]==v for k,v in bound.items()),'EXACT_SOURCE_CALLERS')
    for key in ('selector_key','selector','mode','native_scope','packages','source_root','run_id','receipt_root','scratch_root',
                'output_root','selected_tests','expected_native_ids','source21'):
        require(scope[key]==c[key],'EXACT_SCOPE_'+key)
    review,rr=pair(scope['source_review_handoff_ref'],scope['source_review_manifest_ref'])
    dr=scope['source_review_decision_ref'];decision=decode(read_ref(dr));actor=decision.get('actor_id')
    require(dr in rr and review['source_decision_ref']==dr and review['actor_id']==actor,'SOURCE_DECISION_MEMBER')
    require(decision['schema']=='researchos.w09-three-selector-producer-independent-source-decision.v1'
        and decision['decision']=='SOURCE_ACCEPTED_FOR_ROOT_THREE_SELECTOR_NATIVE'
        and decision['actor_role']=='INDEPENDENT_NON_AUTHOR' and type(actor) is str
        and actor.startswith('codex:/root/') and actor not in (AUTHOR,ROOT_ACTOR),'INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_DECISION')
    for key,want in dict(source_handoff_ref=href,source_manifest_ref=mref,calling_contract_ref=contract_ref,**bound).items():
        require(decision[key]==want,'REVIEW_BINDING_'+key)
    all_choices=decode(read_ref(bound['choice_ref']))
    require(decision['selectors']==all_choices['selectors'] and decision['source21']==c['source21']
        and decision['actual_executed'] is False and type(decision['formal_case_accepted_delta']) is int
        and decision['formal_case_accepted_delta']==0,'SOURCE_REVIEW_BOUNDARY')
    audits=[]
    for ref,who,digest in ((scope['source_author_audit_ref'],AUTHOR,href['sha256']),
        (scope['source_review_audit_ref'],actor,dr['sha256']),(q['scope_audit_ref'],ROOT_ACTOR,sr['sha256'])):
        audits.extend(actual_audit(ref,who,digest))
    issued=datetime.fromisoformat(scope['lease_issued_at']);expires=datetime.fromisoformat(scope['lease_expires_at'])
    require(issued.tzinfo is not None and expires.tzinfo is not None and 0<(expires-issued).total_seconds()<=3600
        and issued<=datetime.now(timezone.utc)<expires and type(scope['lease_id']) is str
        and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}',scope['lease_id']),'CURRENT_FINITE_LEASE')
    vr=q['canonical_vector_ref'];vector=decode(read_ref(vr))
    require(set(vector)=={'schema','checkpoint_revision','ownership_revision','refs'}
        and vector['schema']=='researchos.w09-three-selector-native-canonical-vector.v1'
        and type(vector['checkpoint_revision']) is int and vector['checkpoint_revision']>371
        and type(vector['ownership_revision']) is int and vector['ownership_revision']>175,'POST_REVIEW_CANONICAL_VECTOR')
    require(len(vector['refs'])==4 and [r['path'] for r in vector['refs']]==[str(p) for p in CANON],'FOUR_ORDERED_CURRENT_CANONICAL')
    cp,ow,ss,commands=[decode(read_ref(r)) for r in vector['refs']]
    require(cp['revision']==vector['checkpoint_revision'] and ow['revision']==vector['ownership_revision']
        and cp['project_id']=='aede0678-7308-43dc-b9f2-cfe3d90cfdfb' and cp['head']==c['expected_git_head'],'CURRENT_PROJECT_VECTOR')
    require(ow['active_integrator']['id']==ROOT_ACTOR and ow['shared_integrator']=='qoder-desktop:/root/platform_owner'
        and ow['card_path_bindings']['W09-99']['owner']==ROOT_ACTOR,'ROOT_CURRENT_ROLE')
    require(cp['work_in_progress']['w09_native_producer_scopes'][c['selector_key']]==sr,'CANONICAL_SCOPE_REGISTRATION')
    owner=dict(owner=ROOT_ACTOR,current_source_writer=None,state='ROOT_REGISTERED_PENDING_SELECTOR_NATIVE',scope_ref=sr,
        source_handoff_ref=href,source_manifest_ref=mref,source_review_handoff_ref=scope['source_review_handoff_ref'],
        source_review_manifest_ref=scope['source_review_manifest_ref'],source_root=str(R),selector=c['selector_key'],
        run_id=c['run_id'],receipt_root=c['receipt_root'],scratch_root=c['scratch_root'],output_root=c['output_root'],
        lease_id=scope['lease_id'],lease_issued_at=scope['lease_issued_at'],lease_expires_at=scope['lease_expires_at'],
        formal_case_accepted_delta=0,parent_acceptance=False)
    require(ow['card_path_bindings']['W09-99']['subtasks'][OWNER_KEY+'_'+c['selector_key']]==owner,'EXACT_REGISTERED_OWNER')
    worker=dict(step_id='W09-99',slice_id=SLICE+'_'+c['selector_key'],owner=ROOT_ACTOR,state=owner['state'],scope_ref=sr,
        source_handoff_ref=href,source_review_handoff_ref=scope['source_review_handoff_ref'],run_id=c['run_id'],lease_id=scope['lease_id'])
    require([v for v in cp['workers'] if v.get('slice_id')==worker['slice_id']]==[worker],'UNIQUE_REGISTERED_WORKER')
    require(c['source_root']==str(R) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}',c['run_id'])
        and c['output_root']==str(R/'execution/receipts/W09/retrieval'/('run-'+c['run_id']))
        and c['receipt_root']==str(N/('actual-'+c['selector_key']+'-'+c['run_id']))
        and c['scratch_root']==str(R/'.local'/('w09-full-'+c['selector_key']+'-'+c['run_id'])),'FIXED_PRIVATE_PATHS')
    for ref in c['source21']:read_ref(ref)
    return unique(refs+rr+audits+[request_ref,sr,contract_ref,dr,vr,*vector['refs'],*bound.values()]),scope,vector

def validate_packet(c,packet):
    report_path=packet/'report.json';tool_path=packet/'native-tool-run.json'
    report=decode(report_path.read_bytes());tool=decode(tool_path.read_bytes())
    require(packet==Path(c['output_root']) and report['run_id']==c['run_id']==tool['run_id'],'FIXED_MAIN_NATIVE_RUN')
    require(report['version_manifest']['git_head']==c['expected_git_head'],'ACTUAL_HEAD')
    require(report['version_manifest']['source_sha256']=={Path(ref['path']).relative_to(R).as_posix():'sha256:'+ref['sha256'] for ref in c['source21']},'EXACT_SOURCE21')
    relative=report_path.relative_to(R).as_posix();source=dict(report);source['report_reference']=relative
    require(tool['report_ref']==relative and tool['report_sha256']==pin(report_path)['sha256'],'TOOL_SAME_REPORT')
    require(tool['schema']=='researchos.w09-native-producer-tool-run.v1' and tool['formal_acceptance']=='NOT_RUN','TOOL_SCHEMA')
    require(report['actual_invocation']==tool['actual_invocation']==[c['tool_refs']['go']['path'],*c['go_test_argv_suffix']],'EXACT_NATIVE_ARGV')
    require(report['task_id']=='W09' and report['check_id']==(c['selector']['check_id'] or None)
        and report['case_id']==(c['selector']['case_id'] or None) and report['scope']==c['native_scope'],'EXACT_ROUTE_MODE')
    require(tool['stdout_ref']==report['raw_evidence_references'][0] and tool['stderr_ref']==report['raw_evidence_references'][1]
        and tool['stdout_sha256']==pin(packet/'go-test.stdout.jsonl')['sha256']
        and tool['stderr_sha256']==pin(packet/'go-test.stderr.txt')['sha256'],'EXACT_ORIGINAL_STREAMS')
    require(type(tool['native_exit_code']) is int and tool['native_exit_code']==0 and type(report['exit_code']) is int
        and report['exit_code']==0 and report['timed_out'] is False and report['status']=='PASS','ACTUAL_NATIVE_PASS')
    require(report['formal_construction_acceptance']=='NOT_RUN_POSTRUN_REVIEW_PENDING'
        and type(report['formal_case_accepted_delta']) is int and report['formal_case_accepted_delta']==0,'NATIVE_NOT_FORMAL')
    require(report['selected_tests']==c['selected_tests'] and sorted(report['assertion_ids'])==sorted(c['expected_native_ids']),'EXACT_SELECTED_TESTS_ASSERTIONS')
    closure=module(next(ref for ref in c['source21'] if ref['path']==str(R/'ops/ci/w09_evidence_closure.py')))
    closure.verify_native(R,source,report,c['expected_native_ids'],c['selected_tests'])
    owned=closure.verify_owned(R,source,report,c['selected_tests'],c['assertion_owner'])
    if c['selector_key']=='W09-G01':closure.verify_c19(owned)
    closure.verify_a06(owned)
    require(all(Path(rec['owned_export_ref']['path']).is_relative_to(packet/'owned') for rec in report['assertion_results']),'ABSOLUTE_ASSERTION_PINS')
    return dict(report_ref=pin(report_path),tool_run_ref=pin(tool_path),run_id=c['run_id'],source_root=str(R),
        selector=c['selector'],mode=c['mode'],native_ids=c['expected_native_ids'],native_test_exit=report['exit_code'],
        owned_members=len(owned['members']),mode_independent_review='NOT_RUN_REQUIRED',formal_acceptance=False)

def stage(kind,args):
    require(kind in ('prepare','run') and len(args)==4,'SELECTOR_AND_THREE_EXACT_ROOT_REQUEST_ARGUMENTS')
    c=choice(args[0]);request_ref=dict(path=args[1],sha256=args[2],bytes=int(args[3]))
    auth_refs,scope,vector=validate_authority(request_ref,c)
    gm=module(c['guard_ref']);helper=module(c['owned_job_ref'])
    input_refs,bp=read_inputs(c)
    input_refs=unique(auth_refs+input_refs)
    guards=[];cleanups=[];receipts=[];error=None;primary=None;success=False;created=False;summary=None;packet_ref=None
    actual=Path(c['receipt_root']);scratch=Path(c['scratch_root']);output=Path(c['output_root'])
    stage_root=actual if kind=='prepare' else actual/'producer'
    def acquire(label,refs):
        guard=gm.SourceReadGuard(per_file_cap=MAX,total_cap=2*1024*1024*1024);guards.append((label,guard));guard.acquire(unique(refs));return guard
    try:
        acquire('input',input_refs)
        acquire('runtime',[pin(p) for p in helper.runtime_resource_paths()])
        validate_authority(request_ref,c)
        exact_path(output,True);require(not output.exists(),'ONE_SHOT_OUTPUT_ALREADY_EXISTS')
        if kind=='prepare':
            require(not actual.exists() and not scratch.exists(),'ONE_SHOT_PREPARATION_ALREADY_EXISTS')
            exact_path(actual,True);actual.mkdir();created=True
            exact_path(scratch,True);scratch.mkdir()
            for name in ('profile','temp','gocache'):(scratch/name).mkdir()
            save(actual,'preparation.intent.json',dict(request_ref=request_ref,canonical_vector_ref=pin(scope_path(request_ref)),
                source_root=str(R),run_id=c['run_id'],output_root=str(output),scratch_root=str(scratch),
                source21=c['source21'],all_actual_product_calls=0,formal_acceptance=False))
            summary=dict(schema='researchos.w09-three-selector-preparation-ready.v1',request_ref=request_ref,canonical_vector=vector,
                source_choice_ref=pin(N/'source.choice.json'),environment=build_environment(c),source21=c['source21'],
                run_id=c['run_id'],source_root=str(R),output_root=str(output),scratch_root=str(scratch),
                native_started=False,Main_source_written=False,Canon_written=False)
        else:
            ready_ref=pin(actual/'prepare.ready.json');ready=decode(read_ref(ready_ref))
            require(ready['request_ref']==request_ref and ready['canonical_vector']==vector and ready['status']=='PREPARED_ALL_GUARDS_CLOSED','SAME_PREPARE_VECTOR_REQUEST')
            require(ready['source_choice_ref']==pin(N/'source.choice.json') and ready['source21']==c['source21'] and ready['all_guards_closed'] is True,'PREPARE_CURRENT_SOURCE')
            for ref in ready['guard_cleanup_refs']:require(guard_cleanup_ok(decode(read_ref(ref))),'PREPARE_CLEANUP')
            acquire('preparation',[ready_ref,*ready['guard_cleanup_refs']])
            require(not stage_root.exists(),'ONE_SHOT_PRODUCER_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED');exact_path(stage_root,True);stage_root.mkdir();created=True
            env=build_environment(c);require(env==ready['environment'],'SAME_EXPLICIT_ENVIRONMENT')
            for name in ('profile','temp','gocache'):exact_path(scratch/name)
            require(not any((scratch/'gocache').iterdir()),'FRESH_PRIVATE_GOCACHE')
            save(stage_root,'attempt.intent.json',dict(request_ref=request_ref,canonical_vector=vector,run_id=c['run_id'],
                actual_environment=env,one_go_list=True,one_go_test=True,no_automatic_retry=True))
            list_argv=[c['tool_refs']['go']['path'],*c['list_argv_suffix']]
            validate_authority(request_ref,c);verify_directories(bp)
            receipt,_=invoke(helper,stage_root,'compiler-input-list',list_argv,env,c['list_timeout_seconds']);receipts.append(receipt)
            inv=compiler_inventory((stage_root/'compiler-input-list.stdout.raw').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),c,bp)
            inventory_ref=save(stage_root,'actual-compiler-input-inventory.json',inv)
            acquire('compiler-exports',[inventory_ref,*inv['private_generated_input_refs'],*inv['private_export_refs'],*inv['module_go_mod_refs']])
            permit=save(stage_root,'launcher.permit.json',dict(schema='researchos.w09-three-selector-launcher-permit.v1',request_ref=request_ref,
                selector=c['selector_key'],run_id=c['run_id'],output_root=c['output_root'],launcher_ref=pin(N/'full_w09_launcher.source.py'),
                runner_ref=next(ref for ref in c['source21'] if ref['path']==str(R/'ops/ci/retrieval.py')),environment=env))
            acquire('launcher-permit',[permit])
            argv=[c['tool_refs']['python']['path'],'-I','-S','-B','-X','utf8',str(N/'full_w09_launcher.source.py'),permit['path'],permit['sha256'],str(permit['bytes'])]
            validate_authority(request_ref,c);verify_directories(bp)
            receipt,_=invoke(helper,stage_root,'w09-selector-main-producer',argv,env,c['producer_timeout_seconds']);receipts.append(receipt)
            # Bind the emitted exact run, never select a latest directory or glob.
            emitted=decode((stage_root/'w09-selector-main-producer.stdout.raw').read_bytes())
            require(emitted['report_reference']==(output/'report.json').relative_to(R).as_posix()
                    and emitted['tool_run_reference']==(output/'native-tool-run.json').relative_to(R).as_posix(),'EXACT_PRODUCER_STDOUT_REFS')
            validate_authority(request_ref,c);verify_directories(bp)
            summary=validate_packet(c,output);summary.update(compiler_inventory_ref=inventory_ref,launcher_permit_ref=permit,prepare_ready_ref=ready_ref)
        for ref in input_refs:read_ref(ref)
        success=True
    except BaseException as exc:primary=exc;error=repr(exc)
    finally:
        closed=close_stage_resources(kind,created,c,stage_root,output,guards)
    cleanups=closed['guard_cleanups'];errors=closed['errors'];packet_ref=closed['packet_ref']
    receipts=[row['ref'] for row in closed['invocations'] if row['ref'] is not None]
    all_closed=closed['all_guards_closed'];all_jobs_closed=closed['all_owned_jobs_closed']
    success=success and all_closed and closed['all_cleanup_receipts_saved'] and not errors
    if kind=='run':success=success and packet_ref is not None and len(receipts)==2 and all_jobs_closed
    result=dict(schema='researchos.w09-three-selector-stage-closed.v2',stage=kind,
        status=('PREPARED_ALL_GUARDS_CLOSED' if kind=='prepare' else 'MAIN_SELECTOR_NATIVE_PACKET_CLOSED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW') if success else 'FAILED_NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY',
        error=error,original_exception_type=type(primary).__name__ if primary is not None else None,
        original_invocation_diagnostics=primary.diagnostics if isinstance(primary,EvidenceFailure) else None,
        original_invocation_errors=primary.secondary_errors if isinstance(primary,EvidenceFailure) else [],
        cleanup_errors=errors,summary=summary,native_packet_ref=packet_ref,request_ref=request_ref,
        invocation_refs=receipts,invocation_observations=closed['invocations'],guard_cleanups=cleanups,
        all_guards_closed=all_closed,all_cleanup_receipts_saved=closed['all_cleanup_receipts_saved'],
        actual_formal_consumers=False,formal_case_accepted_delta=0,all_owned_jobs_closed=all_jobs_closed,
        individual_unobserved_native_exits=None,external_model_provider_requests=0,paid_provider_requests=0,
        Main_source_written=False,Canon_written=False,process_loss_requires_explicit_Root_reconciliation=True,automatic_retry=False)
    published=False
    if created:
        try:
            if success and kind=='prepare':
                result.update(summary);result['guard_cleanup_refs']=[row['ref'] for row in cleanups]
                save(actual,'prepare.ready.json',result)
            else:save(stage_root,'validation.closed.json',result)
            published=True
        except BaseException as exc:
            evidence_error(errors,'stage-result-save',exc);result['status']='FAILED_NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY';success=False
    try:
        print(json.dumps(dict(status=result['status'],stage=kind,receipt_root=str(stage_root),error=error,
            cleanup_errors=errors,all_guards_closed=all_closed,all_owned_jobs_closed=all_jobs_closed,
            unsaved_stage_result=result if not published else None)),flush=True)
    except BaseException as exc:
        evidence_error(errors,'stage-progress-write',exc);result['status']='FAILED_NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY';success=False
    if not success:
        raise EvidenceFailure('STAGE_FAILED_NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY',primary,errors,result) from primary

        and ow['card_path_bindings']['W09-99']['owner']==ROOT_ACTOR,'ROOT_CURRENT_ROLE')
    require(cp['work_in_progress']['w09_native_producer_scopes'][c['selector_key']]==sr,'CANONICAL_SCOPE_REGISTRATION')
    owner=dict(owner=ROOT_ACTOR,current_source_writer=None,state='ROOT_REGISTERED_PENDING_SELECTOR_NATIVE',scope_ref=sr,
        source_handoff_ref=href,source_manifest_ref=mref,source_review_handoff_ref=scope['source_review_handoff_ref'],
        source_review_manifest_ref=scope['source_review_manifest_ref'],source_root=str(R),selector=c['selector_key'],
        run_id=c['run_id'],receipt_root=c['receipt_root'],scratch_root=c['scratch_root'],output_root=c['output_root'],
        lease_id=scope['lease_id'],lease_issued_at=scope['lease_issued_at'],lease_expires_at=scope['lease_expires_at'],
        formal_case_accepted_delta=0,parent_acceptance=False)
    require(ow['card_path_bindings']['W09-99']['subtasks'][OWNER_KEY+'_'+c['selector_key']]==owner,'EXACT_REGISTERED_OWNER')
    worker=dict(step_id='W09-99',slice_id=SLICE+'_'+c['selector_key'],owner=ROOT_ACTOR,state=owner['state'],scope_ref=sr,
        source_handoff_ref=href,source_review_handoff_ref=scope['source_review_handoff_ref'],run_id=c['run_id'],lease_id=scope['lease_id'])
    require([v for v in cp['workers'] if v.get('slice_id')==worker['slice_id']]==[worker],'UNIQUE_REGISTERED_WORKER')
    require(c['source_root']==str(R) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}',c['run_id'])
        and c['output_root']==str(R/'execution/receipts/W09/retrieval'/('run-'+c['run_id']))
        and c['receipt_root']==str(N/('actual-'+c['selector_key']+'-'+c['run_id']))
        and c['scratch_root']==str(R/'.local'/('w09-full-'+c['selector_key']+'-'+c['run_id'])),'FIXED_PRIVATE_PATHS')
    for ref in c['source21']:read_ref(ref)
    return unique(refs+rr+audits+[request_ref,sr,contract_ref,dr,vr,*vector['refs'],*bound.values()]),scope,vector

def validate_packet(c,packet):
    report_path=packet/'report.json';tool_path=packet/'native-tool-run.json'
    report=decode(report_path.read_bytes());tool=decode(tool_path.read_bytes())
    require(packet==Path(c['output_root']) and report['run_id']==c['run_id']==tool['run_id'],'FIXED_MAIN_NATIVE_RUN')
    require(report['version_manifest']['git_head']==c['expected_git_head'],'ACTUAL_HEAD')
    require(report['version_manifest']['source_sha256']=={Path(ref['path']).relative_to(R).as_posix():'sha256:'+ref['sha256'] for ref in c['source21']},'EXACT_SOURCE21')
    relative=report_path.relative_to(R).as_posix();source=dict(report);source['report_reference']=relative
    require(tool['report_ref']==relative and tool['report_sha256']==pin(report_path)['sha256'],'TOOL_SAME_REPORT')
    require(tool['schema']=='researchos.w09-native-producer-tool-run.v1' and tool['formal_acceptance']=='NOT_RUN','TOOL_SCHEMA')
    require(report['actual_invocation']==tool['actual_invocation']==[c['tool_refs']['go']['path'],*c['go_test_argv_suffix']],'EXACT_NATIVE_ARGV')
    require(report['task_id']=='W09' and report['check_id']==(c['selector']['check_id'] or None)
        and report['case_id']==(c['selector']['case_id'] or None) and report['scope']==c['native_scope'],'EXACT_ROUTE_MODE')
    require(tool['stdout_ref']==report['raw_evidence_references'][0] and tool['stderr_ref']==report['raw_evidence_references'][1]
        and tool['stdout_sha256']==pin(packet/'go-test.stdout.jsonl')['sha256']
        and tool['stderr_sha256']==pin(packet/'go-test.stderr.txt')['sha256'],'EXACT_ORIGINAL_STREAMS')
    require(type(tool['native_exit_code']) is int and tool['native_exit_code']==0 and type(report['exit_code']) is int
        and report['exit_code']==0 and report['timed_out'] is False and report['status']=='PASS','ACTUAL_NATIVE_PASS')
    require(report['formal_construction_acceptance']=='NOT_RUN_POSTRUN_REVIEW_PENDING'
        and type(report['formal_case_accepted_delta']) is int and report['formal_case_accepted_delta']==0,'NATIVE_NOT_FORMAL')
    require(report['selected_tests']==c['selected_tests'] and sorted(report['assertion_ids'])==sorted(c['expected_native_ids']),'EXACT_SELECTED_TESTS_ASSERTIONS')
    closure=module(next(ref for ref in c['source21'] if ref['path']==str(R/'ops/ci/w09_evidence_closure.py')))
    closure.verify_native(R,source,report,c['expected_native_ids'],c['selected_tests'])
    owned=closure.verify_owned(R,source,report,c['selected_tests'],c['assertion_owner'])
    if c['selector_key']=='W09-G01':closure.verify_c19(owned)
    closure.verify_a06(owned)
    require(all(Path(rec['owned_export_ref']['path']).is_relative_to(packet/'owned') for rec in report['assertion_results']),'ABSOLUTE_ASSERTION_PINS')
    return dict(report_ref=pin(report_path),tool_run_ref=pin(tool_path),run_id=c['run_id'],source_root=str(R),
        selector=c['selector'],mode=c['mode'],native_ids=c['expected_native_ids'],native_test_exit=report['exit_code'],
        owned_members=len(owned['members']),mode_independent_review='NOT_RUN_REQUIRED',formal_acceptance=False)

def path_checked(value,absent=False):
    require(type(value) is str and re.match(r'^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]',value) is not None and '\x00' not in value,'ABSOLUTE_LOCAL_PATH')
    require(':' not in value[2:] and not value.startswith(('\\\\?\\', '\\\\.\\')),'REGULAR_LOCAL_PATH')
    p=Path(value)
    require('..' not in p.parts and str(p)==str(p.absolute()),'NO_PATH_TRAVERSAL')
    for ancestor in (p,*p.parents):
        if not ancestor.exists():
            require(absent and ancestor==p,'EXISTING_PARENT_REQUIRED');continue
        require(not ancestor.is_symlink() and not ancestor.is_junction()
                and not (getattr(ancestor.stat(),'st_file_attributes',0)&0x400),'NO_REPARSE_PATH')
    require(p.resolve(strict=not absent)==p,'NO_PATH_ALIAS')
    return p

def own_source(request,native,core):
    href=request['source_handoff_ref'];mref=request['source_manifest_ref'];h=doc(href);m=doc(mref)
    require(href==pin(N/'HDF.json') and mref==pin(N/'MF.json') and h['manifest_ref']==mref
        and h['schema']=='researchos.w09-root-adoption-source-handoff.v1' and h['actor_id']==AUTHOR
        and h['execution_grant'] is False and h['formal_acceptance'] is False,'OWN_SOURCE_HANDOFF')
    bindings={k:pin(N/name) for k,name in {'caller_ref':'register_w09_adoption.source.py','core_ref':'adoption_core.source.py',
             'main_pair_ref':'main_pair_bytes.source.py','contract_ref':'root-calling-contract.source.json'}.items()}
    require(all(h[k]==ref and ref in m['members'] for k,ref in bindings.items()),'OWN_SOURCE_FILES')
    rhref=request['source_review_handoff_ref'];rmref=request['source_review_manifest_ref'];dref=request['source_review_decision_ref']
    rh,rm,d=doc(rhref),doc(rmref),doc(dref);actor=d.get('actor_id')
    require(rh['manifest_ref']==rmref and rh['source_decision_ref']==dref and dref in rm['members']
        and rh['actor_id']==actor,'OWN_REVIEW_PAIR')
    core.validate_own_review(d,href,mref,bindings)
    refs=[href,mref,rhref,rmref,dref,*bindings.values()];times=[]
    for ref,who,digest in ((request['source_author_audit_ref'],AUTHOR,href['sha256']),
            (request['source_review_audit_ref'],actor,dref['sha256'])):
        held,stamp,_=actual_audit(native,ref,who,digest);refs.extend(held);times.append(stamp)
    return dict(hdf=href,mf=mref,decision=dref,**bindings),refs,times

def model(ctx,before_raw,archive_refs):
    request=ctx['request'];core=ctx['core'];pins=ctx['pins'];out=ctx['out']
    require(len(before_raw)==4 and [pin_raw(p,b) for p,b in zip(CANON,before_raw)]==request['before_canonical_refs'],'EXACT_COMPLETE_BEFORE4')
    docs=[decode(raw) for raw in before_raw];cp,ow=docs[:2]
    require(encoded(cp)==before_raw[0] and encoded(ow)==before_raw[1],'CANON_PAIR_BYTE_INVERSE_ENCODING')
    core.merge_pending(cp,ctx['pending'],request['before_canonical_refs'])
    if request['kind']=='PROFILE_ADOPTION':
        target_before,target_after=profile_outputs(ctx,before_raw)
        after_refs=[pin_raw(p,b) for p,b in zip(MAIN,target_after)]
        scopes={'profile':core.make_q_scope(request,ctx['request_ref'],ctx['audit_ref'],pins,ctx['own'],target_before,after_refs)}
        main_proposals=[pin_raw(out/name,raw) for name,raw in zip(('main.profile.after.proposed.raw','main.commands.after.proposed.raw'),target_after)]
    else:
        validate_profile_commit(ctx,cp,ow)
        choice=doc(pins['NF_choice']);contract=doc(pins['NF_contract'])
        scopes=core.make_native_scopes(request,pins,choice,contract)
        for scope in scopes.values():
            for path in (scope['receipt_root'],scope['scratch_root'],scope['output_root']):
                path_checked(path,True);require(not Path(path).exists(),'NATIVE_ONE_SHOT_PATH_ALREADY_EXISTS')
            for ref in scope['source21']:read_ref(ref);ctx['refs'].append(ref)
        target_before=[];target_after=[];after_refs=[];main_proposals=[]
    scope_refs={key:pin_raw(out/('scope.'+key+'.json'),encoded(value)) for key,value in scopes.items()}
    ca,oa,cops,oops=core.canonical_changes(cp,ow,request,scope_refs,scopes,ctx['pending'],archive_refs,ctx['own'],request['profile_commit_ref'])
    require(encoded(core.inverse_operations(ca,cops))==before_raw[0]
            and encoded(core.inverse_operations(oa,oops))==before_raw[1],'COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_BYTE_INVERSE')
    after_raw=[encoded(ca),encoded(oa)]
    proposed=[pin_raw(out/name,raw) for name,raw in zip(('checkpoint.after.proposed.json','path_ownership.after.proposed.json'),after_raw)]
    result=dict(schema='researchos.root-w09-adoption-registration-plan.v1',kind=request['kind'],issued_by=ROOT,
        request_ref=ctx['request_ref'],root_request_audit_ref=ctx['audit_ref'],output_root=str(out),
        before_canonical_refs=request['before_canonical_refs'],before_archive_refs=archive_refs,
        scope_refs=scope_refs,canonical_after_refs=[pin_raw(p,b) for p,b in zip(CANON[:2],after_raw)]+request['before_canonical_refs'][2:],
        canonical_proposal_refs=proposed,checkpoint_operations=cops,ownership_operations=oops,
        target_before_refs=target_before,target_after_refs=after_refs,main_proposal_refs=main_proposals,
        complete_byte_inverse=True,pending_ref=request['pending_ref'],next_original_failure_ordinal=ctx['pending']['next_original_failure_ordinal'],
        formal_acceptance=False,parent_acceptance=False,formal_case_accepted_delta=0,automatic_retry=False)
    return result,scopes,after_raw,target_after

def validate_own_review(decision,href,mref,bindings):
    actor=decision.get('actor_id')
    require(decision.get('schema')=='researchos.w09-root-adoption-independent-source-decision.v1'
        and decision.get('decision')=='SOURCE_ACCEPTED_FOR_ROOT_W09_ADOPTION'
        and decision.get('actor_role')=='INDEPENDENT_NON_AUTHOR'
        and type(actor) is str and re.fullmatch(r'codex:/root/[a-z0-9_]+(?:/[a-z0-9_]+)*',actor)
        and actor not in (AUTHOR,ROOT) and decision.get('source_author_id')==AUTHOR
        and decision.get('source_handoff_ref')==href and decision.get('source_manifest_ref')==mref
        and all(decision.get(k)==v for k,v in bindings.items())
        and decision.get('actual_executed') is False and decision.get('formal_acceptance') is False
        and decision.get('execution_grant') is False,'OWN_NONAUTHOR_REVIEW_NO_GRANT')
    return actor

def make_native_scopes(request,pins,choice,contract):
    out={}
    require(set(request['native_leases'])==set(SELECTORS),'THREE_NATIVE_LEASES')
    require(len({v['lease_id'] for v in request['native_leases'].values()})==3,'DISTINCT_SELECTOR_LEASES')
    for selector in SELECTORS:
        c={**choice['common'],**choice['selectors'][selector]}
        scope=dict(schema=contract['scope_schema'],status='ROOT_AUTHORIZED_SINGLE_SELECTOR_NATIVE',issued_by=ROOT,executor=ROOT,
            source_handoff_ref=pins['NF_hdf'],source_manifest_ref=pins['NF_mf'],
            source_review_handoff_ref=pins['NR_hdf'],source_review_manifest_ref=pins['NR_mf'],source_review_decision_ref=pins['NR_decision'],
            source_author_audit_ref=request['reviewed_source_audit_refs']['producer-author'],
            source_review_audit_ref=request['reviewed_source_audit_refs']['producer-review'])
        scope.update(copy.deepcopy(contract['bound_source_refs']))
        for key in ('selector_key','selector','mode','native_scope','packages','source_root','run_id','receipt_root','scratch_root',
                    'output_root','selected_tests','expected_native_ids','source21'):
            scope[key]=copy.deepcopy(c[key])
        scope.update(copy.deepcopy(request['native_leases'][selector]))
        scope.update(list_timeout_seconds=240,producer_timeout_seconds=420,inner_Go_timeout_seconds=180,
                     maximum_go_test_runs=1,maximum_go_list_runs=1)
        for name in ('formal_dispatcher','formal_acceptance','Source_mutation','checkpoint_write','ownership_write','step_state_write','worktree_creation','automatic_retry'):
            scope[name]=False
        for name in ZERO_FIELDS:scope[name]=0
        require(set(scope)==set(contract['scope_required_fields']),'EXACT_NF3_SCOPE_FIELDS')
        out[selector]=scope
    return out

def canonical_changes(cp,ow,request,scope_refs,scopes,pending,archives,own,commit_ref=None):
    """Only named fields change; inverse retains every untouched historical field."""
    require(type(cp['revision']) is int and type(ow['revision']) is int,'EXACT_CANON_REVISIONS')
    require(cp['project_id']=='aede0678-7308-43dc-b9f2-cfe3d90cfdfb'
        and ow['active_integrator']['id']==ROOT and ow['shared_integrator']=='qoder-desktop:/root/platform_owner'
        and ow['card_path_bindings']['W09-99']['owner']==ROOT,'CURRENT_ROOT_ROLE')
    require(type(cp['workers']) is list,'CANON_WORKERS')
    merged,next_ordinal=merge_pending(cp,pending,request['before_canonical_refs'])
    co=[];oo=[];work=copy.deepcopy(cp);owners=copy.deepcopy(ow)
    def change(doc,ops,path,value):
        exists,before=value_at(doc,path);op=dict(path=path,before_exists=exists,before=before,after=copy.deepcopy(value))
        ops.append(op);put(doc,path,value)
    if merged!=cp['failure_counters']:change(work,co,['failure_counters'],merged)
    change(work,co,['work_in_progress','root_next_failure_ordinal_live'],next_ordinal)
    workers=copy.deepcopy(cp['workers']);subtasks=ow['card_path_bindings']['W09-99']['subtasks']
    if request['kind']=='PROFILE_ADOPTION':
        require(QKEY not in subtasks and not any(x.get('slice_id')==QSLICE for x in workers)
                and 'w09_profile_adoption_scope_ref' not in cp['work_in_progress'],'FRESH_PROFILE_ADOPTION_SLOT')
        sr=scope_refs['profile'];scope=scopes['profile']
        owner=dict(owner=ROOT,selected_worker_id=ROOT,current_source_writer=None,state=QSTATE,scope_ref=sr,
            source_handoff_ref=own['hdf'],source_review_decision_ref=own['decision'],lease=copy.deepcopy(request['lease']),
            target_before_refs=scope['target_before_refs'],target_after_refs=scope['target_after_refs'],
            formal_acceptance=False,parent_acceptance=False,formal_case_accepted_delta=0)
        worker=dict(step_id='W09-99',slice_id=QSLICE,owner=ROOT,selected_worker_id=ROOT,state=QSTATE,
            scope_ref=sr,source_handoff_ref=own['hdf'],source_review_decision_ref=own['decision'],lease_id=request['lease']['lease_id'])
        workers.append(worker)
        change(owners,oo,['card_path_bindings','W09-99','subtasks',QKEY],owner)
        change(work,co,['work_in_progress','w09_profile_adoption_scope_ref'],sr)
        change(work,co,['work_in_progress','w09_profile_adoption_registration'],dict(status=QSTATE,
            scope_ref=sr,before_canonical_archive_refs=archives,pending_ref=request['pending_ref'],
            registered_new_diagnostic_count=len(pending['pending']),main23_qualification_ref=request['main23_qualification_ref'],
            main23_qualification_authority_for_W09=False,formal_case_accepted_delta=0,parent_acceptance=False))
    else:
        require(request['kind']=='NATIVE_SCOPES' and commit_ref is not None,'NATIVE_AFTER_PROFILE_COMMIT')
        require(QKEY in subtasks and subtasks[QKEY]['state']==QSTATE,'REGISTERED_PROFILE_SLOT')
        profile_owner=copy.deepcopy(subtasks[QKEY]);profile_owner.update(state=QDONE,actual_adoption_ref=commit_ref)
        change(owners,oo,['card_path_bindings','W09-99','subtasks',QKEY],profile_owner)
        qworkers=[x for x in workers if x.get('slice_id')==QSLICE]
        require(len(qworkers)==1 and qworkers[0]['state']==QSTATE,'UNIQUE_PROFILE_WORKER')
        qworkers[0].update(state=QDONE,actual_adoption_ref=commit_ref)
        reg=copy.deepcopy(cp['work_in_progress']['w09_profile_adoption_registration'])
        require(reg['status']==QSTATE,'PROFILE_REGISTRATION_STATE')
        reg.update(status=QDONE,actual_adoption_ref=commit_ref)
        change(work,co,['work_in_progress','w09_profile_adoption_registration'],reg)
        old_native=cp['work_in_progress'].get('w09_native_producer_scopes',{})
        require(type(old_native) is dict and not any(k in old_native for k in SELECTORS),'FRESH_THREE_NATIVE_SLOTS')
        native=copy.deepcopy(old_native)
        for selector in SELECTORS:
            require(NKEY+'_'+selector not in subtasks and not any(x.get('slice_id')==NSLICE+'_'+selector for x in workers),'FRESH_NATIVE_OWNER_WORKER')
            owner,worker=native_owner_worker(scopes[selector],scope_refs[selector]);workers.append(worker)
            change(owners,oo,['card_path_bindings','W09-99','subtasks',NKEY+'_'+selector],owner);native[selector]=scope_refs[selector]
        change(work,co,['work_in_progress','w09_native_producer_scopes'],native)
        change(work,co,['work_in_progress','w09_nf3_scope_registration'],dict(scope_refs=scope_refs,before_canonical_archive_refs=archives,
            pending_ref=request['pending_ref'],profile_adoption_ref=commit_ref,formal_case_accepted_delta=0,parent_acceptance=False))
    change(work,co,['workers'],workers)
    for key,value in dict(revision=cp['revision']+1,expected_previous_revision=cp['revision'],updated_at=request['created_utc'],
            updated_by=ROOT,note='Root bounded W09 '+request['kind']+' registration; no formal acceptance.').items():change(work,co,[key],value)
    for key,value in dict(revision=ow['revision']+1,updated_at=request['created_utc'],updated_by=ROOT).items():change(owners,oo,[key],value)
    require(inverse_operations(work,co)==cp and inverse_operations(owners,oo)==ow,'COMPLETE_STRUCTURAL_INVERSE')
    require(work['failure_counters'][:len(cp['failure_counters'])]==cp['failure_counters'],'ALL_OLD_FAILURES_UNCHANGED')
    return work,owners,co,oo

def verify_mode(root, source, report, route, ctx, native, decision_ref, decision_sha):
    """A later non-author decision must bind this run; absent facts fail closed."""
    require(isinstance(decision_ref, str) and decision_ref and isinstance(decision_sha, str)
            and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", decision_sha), "REVIEWED_MODE_DECISION_MISSING")
    decision_path = safe_repo_rel(root, decision_ref)
    require(digest(decision_path.read_bytes()) == decision_sha, "MODE_DECISION_PIN_DRIFT")
    decision = json.loads(decision_path.read_bytes())
    mode = "LIVE_WINDOWS" if route[2] == "W09-G02" else "FIXTURE"
    require(decision.get("schema") == "researchos.w09-mode-decision.v2"
            and decision.get("route") == list(route) and decision.get("mode") == mode
            and decision.get("run_id") == native["run_id"]
            and decision.get("report_ref") == source["report_reference"]
            and decision.get("report_sha256") == digest((root / source["report_reference"]).read_bytes())
            and decision.get("stdout_sha256") == native["stdout"]["sha256"]
            and decision.get("source_sha256") == native["source_hashes"]
            and decision.get("go_executable") == native["go"]
            and decision.get("producer_id") and decision.get("reviewer_id")
            and decision["producer_id"] != decision["reviewer_id"]
            and decision.get("reviewer_role") == "INDEPENDENT_NON_AUTHOR"
            and decision.get("decision") == "QUALIFIED", "MODE_DECISION_CURRENT_RUN_NOT_CLOSED")
    reviewer_pin = decision.get("independent_review_ref")
    require(isinstance(reviewer_pin, dict) and set(reviewer_pin) == {"path", "sha256", "bytes"},
            "INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_RECEIPT_MISSING")
    reviewer_path, reviewer_raw = safe_repo_pin(root, reviewer_pin)
    report_dir = safe_repo_rel(root, source["report_reference"]).parent
    require(report_dir not in reviewer_path.parents,
            "REVIEWER_RECEIPT_OWNED_BY_PRODUCER")
    review = json.loads(reviewer_raw)
    require(review.get("schema") == "researchos.w09-independent-mode-review.v1"
            and review.get("actor_id") == decision["reviewer_id"]
            and review.get("actor_role") == "INDEPENDENT_NON_AUTHOR"
            and review.get("producer_id") == decision["producer_id"]
            and review.get("run_id") == native["run_id"]
            and review.get("report_sha256") == decision["report_sha256"]
            and review.get("source_sha256") == native["source_hashes"]
            and review.get("go_executable") == native["go"]
            and review.get("run_os") == report["version_manifest"]["os"]
            and review.get("run_os_release") == report["version_manifest"]["os_release"]
            and review.get("decision") == "QUALIFIED", "INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_NOT_CURRENT")
    if mode == "FIXTURE":
        require(decision.get("input_origin") == "OWNED_TEMP_DIR"
                and all(x["value"].get("delivery") == "IN_PROCESS_HTTptest_RECORDER"
                        for x in ctx["events"].get("http-exchange", []))
                and any(x["value"].get("root_path") and
                        Path(x["value"]["root_path"]).is_relative_to(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()))
                        for k, v in ctx["events"].items() if k.startswith("state-") for x in v),
                "FIXTURE_INPUT_NOT_ACTUAL")
    else:
        lock = json.loads((root / "execution/toolchains/locked.json").read_bytes())
        host = decision.get("host_witness")
        junction = decision.get("junction_witness")
        require(os.name == "nt" and platform.system() == "Windows"
                and platform.machine().lower() in {"amd64", "x86_64"}
                and int(platform.version().split(".")[-1]) >= 22000
                and decision.get("locked_go_sha256") == lock["tools"]["go"]["sha256"]
                and isinstance(host, dict) and isinstance(junction, dict), "LIVE_HOST_NOT_ACTUAL")
        expected_witnesses = {json.dumps(host, sort_keys=True), json.dumps(junction, sort_keys=True)}
        require(len(expected_witnesses) == 2 and
                {json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True) for item in decision.get("witness_allowlist", [])}
                == expected_witnesses, "HOST_WITNESS_NOT_IN_FROZEN_RUN_ALLOWLIST")
        witness_values = {}
        for item, schema in ((host, "researchos.w09-host-witness.v1"),
                             (junction, "researchos.w09-junction-witness.v1")):
            _, raw = safe_repo_pin(root, item)
            witness = json.loads(raw)
            require(witness.get("schema") == schema and witness.get("run_id") == native["run_id"]
                    and witness.get("report_sha256") == decision["report_sha256"]
                    and witness.get("go_executable") == native["go"]
                    and witness.get("source_sha256") == native["source_hashes"]
                    and witness.get("actual_platform") == "Windows 11 x64", "HOST_WITNESS_CURRENT_RUN")
            witness_values[schema] = witness
        branch = only(ctx["events"], "g02-os-branch", "TestW09RootReplacementCannotFeedProduct")
        junction_event = only(ctx["events"], "g02-junction-command", "TestW09RootReplacementCannotFeedProduct")
        require(branch.get("goos") == "windows" and branch.get("goarch") == "amd64"
                and branch.get("junction_branch") is True
                and junction_event.get("exit_code") == 0
                and isinstance(junction_event.get("root_path"), str)
                and isinstance(junction_event.get("target_path"), str)
                and Path(junction_event["root_path"]).is_absolute()
                and Path(junction_event["target_path"]).is_absolute()
                and junction_event["root_path"] != junction_event["target_path"]
                and junction_event.get("command") == ["cmd.exe", "/c", "mklink", "/J",
                                                      junction_event["root_path"],
                                                      junction_event["target_path"]]
                and junction_event.get("command") ==
                    witness_values["researchos.w09-junction-witness.v1"].get("command")
                and junction_event.get("root_path") == decision.get("junction_root_path")
                and junction_event.get("target_path") == decision.get("junction_target_path")
                and junction_event.get("output") ==
                    witness_values["researchos.w09-junction-witness.v1"].get("output_pin")
                and _raw_pin(junction_event["output"], ctx["members"], "TestW09RootReplacementCannotFeedProduct") is not None,
                "JUNCTION_RAW_NOT_BOUND")
    return {"mode": mode, "decision_ref": decision_ref, "decision_sha256": decision_sha,
            "formal_authority": False}
